title: Organizer cancels pre-registration with a reason
description: Cancel a collecting event and pick a preset reason (and optional details) for the email to invited and registered players.

steps.title: Cancel
steps.body: Cancel removes the pre-registration and emails players who have an address. This capture does not confirm it.

steps.title: Preset reason
steps.body: Choose a club preset such as Tournament cancelled by organizer or Not enough registered players, add details if needed, then Confirm Cancel — or Keep Registration.
steps.resultNote: Cancel Tournament Registration dialog with reason presets.
